shared_elements: upright pillar-like/stele forms standing in a row
relief carved into a vertical rock surface
justification:
A presents a dense, legible figural program 
tiers of quadrupeds in a row above a banded register, then birds and animals in profile and a long-necked bird low down
while B shows only eroded vertical pillar-like masses set into a rock face with almost no discernible figural detail. The only correspondence is the generic notion of upright, roughly anthropomorphic/pillar-shaped elements standing side by side in a vertical carved surface; the specific animals, registers and profile conventions of A have no counterpart in B.
